messages:
marta: Heads up — planning to swap prod overlay namespace from `prod-core` -> `prod-core-v2` as part of a Terraform rename. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4825. Need a quick sanity check on secrets wiring, RBAC, and any hardcoded monitoring labels. This will be gated, but want to catch blockers early. @jordan @lee
jordan: Skimming PR now — main thing: kustomize overlays reference `secretRef: prod-core` in two apps; that'll need updating. Also roleBinding subjects reference serviceAccount in `prod-core`.
lee: Are we doing a full rename in overlay or adding an alias? If rename, update ArgoCD app `namespace` field and ClusterRoleBinding subjects. If alias, we must ensure no resources are duplicated.
infra-bot: terraform plan shows: - kubernetes_namespace.prod-core -> will be replaced by kubernetes_namespace.prod-core-v2 (resource rename), aws_secretsmanager_secret_policy.* changed. See plan link: https://ci.redwood/plan/4825
samir: Quick secrets note: Shared secret paths still under `prod-core/...`. I suggest adding a short-lived alias mapping in the secretsmanager module so consumers don't break during rollout. I can add a TF var `legacy_namespace_alias = "prod-core"` and populate a placeholder secret version for 24-48h.
marta: Thanks. We also have a release-gating check that blocks namespace renames if any live rollout has >2% pod restarts in the last 15m. How do we validate that before promote? Where can I see the metrics quickly?
ops-sre: Use the infra dashboard -> Deployments -> Namespace rollouts. For quick check run: `kubectl -n prod-canary rollout status deploy/ingress --watch` and `kubectl -n prod-canary get pods --sort-by=.status.restartCount`. I'll run the probe and post results.
jordan: I'll push a tiny PR to update the kustomize overlays (serviceAccount references + secretRef). ETA ~30m. Will include a note in PR description about the secret alias plan.
lee: Also remember Prometheus scrape configs reference `namespace: prod-core` in a couple of relabel_configs. ops-sre please ensure dashboards pick up `prod-core-v2` or use a relabel to keep old metrics streaming.
ops-sre: Good catch. I'll add a temporary scrape relabel and an alert suppression window for the swap period. Will create a ticket and link here.
marta: If we get +1s by EOD I'll schedule staging->prod promote tomorrow 09:00 PT. Post-deploy I'll run a quick smoke job to verify traffic and secrets access. Also adding a post-deploy TF job to copy the KMS alias for secrets.
samir: Example snippet I'll add to keep legacy alias available:
```
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "legacy_alias" {
  secret_id     = aws_secretsmanager_secret.prod_core.id
  secret_string = jsonencode({legacy_namespace = "prod-core"})
}
```
This will create a tiny version that callers using the old path can still reference for 24h.
jordan: :thumbsup: pushing overlay update now.
lee: LGTM from k8s manifest side once roleBinding subject and relabels are fixed.
ops-sre: Ticket created: INFRA-2718 (scrape relabel + suppression). I'll run pre-promote readiness at 08:30 PT tomorrow.
marta: Thanks everyone. Tagging this thread for audit in #release-gating. If you hit anything blocking, drop it here and I'll hold the promote.
